metadata.title: Clicked like I was swatting a fly and somehow scored a lucky 1 kill? Valorant logic broke
metadata.description:
Pressed every button like a confused squirrel on caffeine.
Enemy probably asking ‘Did I just get played by a potato?’
Did NOT deserve that but hey, chaos is my best friend.
If your aim’s more accident than skill, you’ll get this.

Hit like if your aim’s a beautiful disaster!

#valorant #gamingfails #luckshot #funnygaming #shorts
